page0.text:
...Yeah.
I should go check on Sakura before the sun sets.

page1.text:
"Fuji-nee, I'm going out for a bit. I don't know what you're up to, but I'll leave dinner to you."
"Okay, take care. Dinner's going to be delicious crab egg foo young."
Crab egg foo young, huh?
Well, I guess even Fuji-nee should be able to make that.

page2.text:
I head up the hill as the sun sets.
As it's still winter, it's setting early.
I need to hurry and go to the Matou household so I can check up on Sakura.

page3.text:
"Oh, Senpai? Why are you here at this time?"
"Oh... Well, I just felt like it. I was just passing by, so I thought I'd drop in."
"Passing by? Okay, whatever you say."

page4.text:
My flustered state must've been funny, as Sakura smiles.
Her expression is genuine, and it doesn't look like she's been harassed by Shinji.

page5.text:
"Sakura. I really don't have any business here, but what's Shinji doing?
Is he home right now?"
"No, I don't think he's home yet."

page6.text:
"...Not home yet...? Then who called my house? Didn't Shinji tell you to come back here?"
Huh...? Well, Ms. Fujimura just told me to go home since my grandfather was waiting, so I'm not sure...

page7.text:
...
I see.
...But it is true that Shinji hasn't talked to Sakura at all.
Shinji's her brother after all.
He would never involve such a good sister in this battle between Masters.

page8.text: ...And there's one thing I have to tell her so I don't involve her in this mess.

page10.text:
We stare at each other blankly.
Ten seconds pass with us just goofily staring at each other.

page11.text: "U-um... I'm a bit disappointed, but I'm relieved to hear that from you. I was told to stay at home and not go anywhere at night for a while."

page12.text: "Y-yeah, that's right. It's been dangerous lately, so we should've done so earlier... See you, Sakura."

page13.text:
"Yes. I will refrain from going to your house for a while.
I'm a little disappointed, but I suppose things will return to normal eventually. Until then, please come visit the kyudo club, Senpai."

page14.text: Sakura bows and goes back into her house.

page15.text:
I manage to make it back before dinner.
I tell Saber, who was angrily waiting for me at the entrance, about what happened today and how we eliminated the Bounded Field at school, as well as Tohsaka anticipating a counterattack tomorrow.

page16.text:
...I don't tell her about Shinji.
I don't want her to consider him an enemy until his true intentions are clear.

page17.text:
"I understand. Then let us eat, Shirou. Taiga has made dinner and has been waiting."
She must be hungry, as Saber makes her way quickly to the living room.

page18.text:
"I see. I haven't eaten anything she's made since I was a kid."
I'm half worried and half looking forward to it.

page19.text:
...Man.
Who would have imagined that it was going to turn into such a disaster...?
